boundary: Acceptance proves Batch 6 explicit package authority registration, currentness observations and lexical discovery. It does not promote providers, broad standards families or unbound security taxonomies into authority truth.
deferredCandidates: METS 1.12.1 as a supported compatibility line; register when a workload explicitly targets METS 1 rather than METS 2
Siegfried because it is a provider/tool, not semantic authority
DAMA-DMBOK until a concrete organizational data-governance workload binds that body of knowledge
Design Council Double Diamond until a real product-discovery profile needs a stable reference identity
RIPE Atlas because it is a measurement service/provider rather than a protocol standard
SMPTE family until an actual media deliverable identifies the specific standard number
CVSS/CWE/CVE/ATT&CK/CIS/SAMM until a Security workload actually binds them
